title: PostgreSQL (SQL)
description: The world's most advanced open-source relational database — production-grade, full-featured, free.
body:
## What is it?

PostgreSQL (often "Postgres") is a powerful open-source relational database. It's the default choice for most web applications that need a relational database — free, reliable, scalable, and excellent tooling.

## Why it matters

PostgreSQL handles everything from tiny side projects to production systems at scale (Notion, Figma, Shopify). Learning it gives you a skill that transfers to any relational database.

## Key data types

```sql
id        SERIAL PRIMARY KEY      -- auto-increment integer
name      TEXT NOT NULL           -- variable-length string
price     DECIMAL(10,2)           -- currency
active    BOOLEAN DEFAULT true    -- true/false
created   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() -- timestamp with timezone
data      JSONB                   -- JSON stored as binary
```

## Indexes

```sql
CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);
```

## ORMs vs Raw SQL

- **ORMs** (Prisma, Drizzle): Write JS/TS — faster to develop, type-safe
- **Raw SQL**: More control, better for complex queries
- Learn both — ORMs abstract SQL but you'll need raw SQL when they fall short
